description: PCRF rejected new policy sessions. DIAMETER_TOO_BUSY responses rose to 38% on the Gx peer.
resolution: Removed the stale route and reset the Gx peer; session success returned to 99.8%
root_cause: A stale Diameter route kept traffic on a drained policy node
summary: PCRF rejected new policy sessions
symptoms: DIAMETER_TOO_BUSY responses rose to 38% on the Gx peer

description: HLR lookup timeouts delayed location updates. MAP UpdateLocation calls exceeded the three-second timeout.
resolution: Rebuilt the index online and restarted the blocked worker pool
root_cause: A locked database index blocked the subscriber_location table
summary: HLR lookup timeouts delayed location updates
symptoms: MAP UpdateLocation calls exceeded the three-second timeout

description: Outbound SMS delivery queue grew continuously. SMPP submit_sm latency exceeded 12 seconds and the queue reached 1.8 million messages.
resolution: Applied the current bind profile and drained the queue in controlled batches
root_cause: One bind used an obsolete throughput cap after a partner migration
summary: Outbound SMS delivery queue grew continuously
symptoms: SMPP submit_sm latency exceeded 12 seconds and the queue reached 1.8 million messages

description: LTE attach failures spiked after a tracking-area change. Attach Reject cause 15 appeared for TAC 4102.
resolution: Added TAC 4102 to the served-TA list and performed a rolling config reload
root_cause: The new tracking area was absent from the MME served-TA list
summary: LTE attach failures spiked after a tracking-area change
symptoms: Attach Reject cause 15 appeared for TAC 4102

description: Intermittent packet loss affected anchored LTE sessions. GTP-U sequence gaps reached 4.2% during busy hour.
resolution: Restored the mobile-core queue profile and cleared the congested queue
root_cause: A line-card queue profile was incorrectly set to best effort
summary: Intermittent packet loss affected anchored LTE sessions
symptoms: GTP-U sequence gaps reached 4.2% during busy hour

description: New mobile data sessions failed during evening peak. Create Session succeeded but address allocation returned NAT_POOL_EXHAUSTED.
resolution: Added the reserved address block and rebalanced allocations across pools
root_cause: The Gi public NAT pool had no free addresses
summary: New mobile data sessions failed during evening peak
symptoms: Create Session succeeded but address allocation returned NAT_POOL_EXHAUSTED

description: All sectors on one eNodeB went out of service. Cells BRS1042A, BRS1042B, and BRS1042C reported VSWR alarms.
resolution: Replaced the junction, resealed the cabinet, and completed a sweep test
root_cause: Water ingress damaged the feeder junction after overnight storms
summary: All sectors on one eNodeB went out of service
symptoms: Cells BRS1042A, BRS1042B, and BRS1042C reported VSWR alarms

description: IMS registrations intermittently returned service unavailable. SIP 503 responses appeared every five minutes on one P-CSCF.
resolution: Raised the probe timeout and rolled the P-CSCF deployment
root_cause: A health probe recycled healthy workers because its DNS timeout was too short
summary: IMS registrations intermittently returned service unavailable
symptoms: SIP 503 responses appeared every five minutes on one P-CSCF

description: Calls to one carrier timed out before answer. SIP INVITE transactions ended with 408 on trunk TG-441.
resolution: Added the approved peer address and removed the obsolete route
root_cause: The carrier changed its signalling IP without completing the change record
summary: Calls to one carrier timed out before answer
symptoms: SIP INVITE transactions ended with 408 on trunk TG-441

description: Handsets could not resolve the enterprise APN. Queries for corp5g.apn returned NXDOMAIN only in Wales.
resolution: Corrected the transfer ACL and forced a full zone transfer
root_cause: A zone transfer excluded the delegated corp5g record
summary: Handsets could not resolve the enterprise APN
symptoms: Queries for corp5g.apn returned NXDOMAIN only in Wales

description: Core routes flapped between London and Manchester. BGP neighbour 172.20.14.2 reset 46 times in an hour.
resolution: Replaced the optic and cleaned both fibre ends
root_cause: A damaged optic caused intermittent loss of signal on xe-0/0/7
summary: Core routes flapped between London and Manchester
symptoms: BGP neighbour 172.20.14.2 reset 46 times in an hour

description: OSPF adjacency remained in EXSTART after a router upgrade. The adjacency on ae12 never reached FULL.
resolution: Aligned both interfaces to MTU 9100 and reset the adjacency
root_cause: The two ends used MTU 9100 and MTU 9000
summary: OSPF adjacency remained in EXSTART after a router upgrade
symptoms: The adjacency on ae12 never reached FULL

description: New label-switched paths could not be established. LDP logged label allocation failures above 95% utilisation.
resolution: Cleared the orphaned bindings and expanded the label range
root_cause: Orphaned labels remained after an aborted maintenance job
summary: New label-switched paths could not be established
symptoms: LDP logged label allocation failures above 95% utilisation

description: Provider-edge control-plane CPU stayed above 92%. SNMP polling generated 18,000 requests per minute.
resolution: Restored the 60-second interval and staggered polling
root_cause: A monitoring template applied a one-second interval to every interface OID
summary: Provider-edge control-plane CPU stayed above 92%
symptoms: SNMP polling generated 18,000 requests per minute

description: Optical channel power deteriorated across the north path. CH-47 receive power fell to -18.7 dBm.
resolution: Re-routed and replaced the patch lead, restoring receive power to -6.1 dBm
root_cause: A patch lead was sharply bent in the Newcastle rack
summary: Optical channel power deteriorated across the north path
symptoms: CH-47 receive power fell to -18.7 dBm

description: Rural backhaul errors increased during heavy rain. Adaptive modulation dropped from 256-QAM to QPSK.
resolution: Realigned the antenna and verified a 28 dB fade margin
root_cause: A misaligned antenna reduced fade margin below design
summary: Rural backhaul errors increased during heavy rain
symptoms: Adaptive modulation dropped from 256-QAM to QPSK

description: Sixty-four premises lost fibre service. All ONTs on PON-3/2 entered LOS simultaneously.
resolution: Reconnected and secured the tray, then verified all 64 ONTs online
root_cause: A splitter tray was disconnected during contractor work
summary: Sixty-four premises lost fibre service
symptoms: All ONTs on PON-3/2 entered LOS simultaneously

description: Broadband customers looped at authentication. PPPoE sessions received repeated Access-Reject messages.
resolution: Synchronized the secret through the credential vault and cleared stale sessions
root_cause: The RADIUS shared secret differed after a BRAS replacement
summary: Broadband customers looped at authentication
symptoms: PPPoE sessions received repeated Access-Reject messages

description: Customers could attach but could not open new internet connections. Port-block allocation exceeded 99.5%.
resolution: Reduced the UDP idle timer under the approved policy and added a port block
root_cause: A gaming promotion created unusually long UDP mappings
summary: Customers could attach but could not open new internet connections
symptoms: Port-block allocation exceeded 99.5%

description: Policy and charging traffic was silently dropped. Gx requests matched the default deny rule on VLAN-318.
resolution: Added the approved subnet and validated Diameter connectivity
root_cause: A firewall object group omitted the new PCRF subnet
summary: Policy and charging traffic was silently dropped
symptoms: Gx requests matched the default deny rule on VLAN-318

description: VoLTE calls had one-way audio toward fixed networks. SIP signalling completed but inbound RTP counters remained zero.
resolution: Corrected the ACL and verified bidirectional RTP on test calls
root_cause: A return-path ACL omitted the media gateway subnet
summary: VoLTE calls had one-way audio toward fixed networks
symptoms: SIP signalling completed but inbound RTP counters remained zero

description: VoWiFi devices failed secure tunnel establishment. IKE_AUTH failed with certificate unknown for iOS clients.
resolution: Installed the full chain and reloaded the IPsec service
root_cause: The ePDG certificate chain lacked the renewed intermediate CA
summary: VoWiFi devices failed secure tunnel establishment
symptoms: IKE_AUTH failed with certificate unknown for iOS clients

description: 5G registrations were rejected in a newly launched area. Registration Reject cause tracking area not allowed affected TAC 5017.
resolution: Added TAC 5017 and rolled the AMF instances one at a time
root_cause: TAC 5017 was missing from the AMF tracking-area configuration
summary: 5G registrations were rejected in a newly launched area
symptoms: Registration Reject cause tracking area not allowed affected TAC 5017

description: Enterprise devices could register but not establish data sessions. PDU Session Reject reported missing or unknown DNN factory.private.
resolution: Added the approved DNN-to-UPF mapping and reloaded the profile
root_cause: The DNN mapping was absent from the production SMF profile
summary: Enterprise devices could register but not establish data sessions
symptoms: PDU Session Reject reported missing or unknown DNN factory.private

description: Large packets failed across the 5G user plane. ICMP worked while payloads above 1420 bytes were lost.
resolution: Set the N3 MTU to 1400 and enabled path MTU discovery
root_cause: The transport path did not support the UPF's configured MTU 1500
summary: Large packets failed across the 5G user plane
symptoms: ICMP worked while payloads above 1420 bytes were lost

description: Recently upgraded subscribers retained old service profiles. UDM responses served the previous AMBR for up to six hours.
resolution: Corrected the topic name and invalidated affected subscriber cache entries
root_cause: Cache invalidation events were not consumed after a topic rename
summary: Recently upgraded subscribers retained old service profiles
symptoms: UDM responses served the previous AMBR for up to six hours

description: Authentication vector checks failed intermittently. AUTN validation errors peaked at 27% across two AUSF pods.
resolution: Restored NTP access and restarted only the affected pods
root_cause: Node clocks drifted 94 seconds after NTP filtering changed
summary: Authentication vector checks failed intermittently
symptoms: AUTN validation errors peaked at 27% across two AUSF pods

description: Network functions received intermittent discovery not found responses. NRF returned HTTP 404 for healthy SMF instances.
resolution: Removed stale registrations and resynchronized the replica
root_cause: Expired registrations persisted on one replica after database failover
summary: Network functions received intermittent discovery not found responses
symptoms: NRF returned HTTP 404 for healthy SMF instances

description: Industrial devices were assigned to the consumer slice. S-NSSAI 1-010203 resolved to the default UPF group.
resolution: Restored the condition and replayed failed selection requests
root_cause: A slice mapping lost its enterprise tracking-area condition
summary: Industrial devices were assigned to the consumer slice
symptoms: S-NSSAI 1-010203 resolved to the default UPF group

description: Unlimited plans were incorrectly rate limited. The PCF installed a 10 Mbps QoS rule for premium subscribers.
resolution: Rolled back the package and deployed the corrected product mapping
root_cause: A policy package used the legacy product-code mapping
summary: Unlimited plans were incorrectly rate limited
symptoms: The PCF installed a 10 Mbps QoS rule for premium subscribers

description: Prepaid calls failed at authorization. Diameter CCR-Initial requests timed out after two seconds.
resolution: Terminated abandoned queries and raised the pool after capacity review
root_cause: A database connection pool was exhausted by abandoned balance queries
summary: Prepaid calls failed at authorization
symptoms: Diameter CCR-Initial requests timed out after two seconds

description: Charging records accumulated before billing export. The mediation backlog reached 22 million CDRs.
resolution: Archived the audit partition and replayed CDR batches with reconciliation
root_cause: A full audit partition left insufficient working disk space
summary: Charging records accumulated before billing export
symptoms: The mediation backlog reached 22 million CDRs

description: Some retried top-ups credited balances twice. Duplicate credits shared one external transaction reference.
resolution: Enforced idempotency before posting and reversed confirmed duplicates
root_cause: The retry path bypassed the idempotency-key lookup
summary: Some retried top-ups credited balances twice
symptoms: Duplicate credits shared one external transaction reference

description: A contracted discount was absent from July invoices. Accounts on plan ENT-FLEX-24 received the standard rate.
resolution: Corrected the effective date and generated adjustment notes
root_cause: The discount rule's effective date used the wrong timezone
summary: A contracted discount was absent from July invoices
symptoms: Accounts on plan ENT-FLEX-24 received the standard rate

description: Calls to recently ported numbers went to the donor network. Routing lookups returned a stale portability prefix for four ranges.
resolution: Installed the renewed client chain and replayed all missed deltas
root_cause: The MNP delta feed stopped after a certificate renewal
summary: Calls to recently ported numbers went to the donor network
symptoms: Routing lookups returned a stale portability prefix for four ranges

description: Inbound roamers could not attach from one partner. Diameter requests failed with DIAMETER_UNABLE_TO_DELIVER.
resolution: Added the approved realm route and validated test IMSIs
root_cause: The partner realm was missing from the DRA routing table
summary: Inbound roamers could not attach from one partner
symptoms: Diameter requests failed with DIAMETER_UNABLE_TO_DELIVER

description: Delivery receipts were not returned to one partner. Messages delivered but DLRs remained in ENROUTE state.
resolution: Enabled the partner-specific hexadecimal conversion and replayed receipts
root_cause: The partner expected receipted_message_id in hexadecimal
summary: Delivery receipts were not returned to one partner
symptoms: Messages delivered but DLRs remained in ENROUTE state

description: Emergency calls connected without dispatchable location. The PIDF-LO body was absent for Wi-Fi originated calls.
resolution: Excluded emergency traffic from the rule and verified location delivery
root_cause: A header normalization rule removed the location-routing key
summary: Emergency calls connected without dispatchable location
symptoms: The PIDF-LO body was absent for Wi-Fi originated calls

description: Approved warrant records stopped transferring to the mediation gateway. TLS negotiation failed immediately after certificate rotation.
resolution: Added the issuing CA through the controlled change and replayed encrypted records
root_cause: The gateway trust store lacked the new issuing CA
summary: Approved warrant records stopped transferring to the mediation gateway
symptoms: TLS negotiation failed immediately after certificate rotation

description: A single access-ring fault created 48,000 alarms. Downstream alarms were not suppressed under the root LOS event.
resolution: Re-imported topology and re-ran alarm correlation
root_cause: A topology import omitted parent-child relationships
summary: A single access-ring fault created 48,000 alarms
symptoms: Downstream alarms were not suppressed under the root LOS event

description: Automated ticket creation started returning unauthorized. POST requests to the ITSM API returned HTTP 401.
resolution: Pinned the adapter to the current vault version and restarted it
root_cause: The client secret rotated but the adapter still used the previous vault version
summary: Automated ticket creation started returning unauthorized
symptoms: POST requests to the ITSM API returned HTTP 401

description: Monthly availability reports counted planned work as downtime. The maintenance exclusion window shifted by one hour.
resolution: Normalized calculations to UTC and regenerated the monthly report
root_cause: The calculator parsed UTC timestamps as Europe/London local time
summary: Monthly availability reports counted planned work as downtime
symptoms: The maintenance exclusion window shifted by one hour

description: A compliant router fleet was flagged for weak ciphers. The audit reported aes128-cbc despite its removal from devices.
resolution: Switched collection to running config and invalidated the cache
root_cause: The collector parsed cached startup configs instead of running configs
summary: A compliant router fleet was flagged for weak ciphers
symptoms: The audit reported aes128-cbc despite its removal from devices

description: The assistant API restarted under normal traffic. Kubernetes pods were OOMKilled when concurrent prompts exceeded 30.
resolution: Added context budgeting and raised the reviewed memory limit
root_cause: Prompt contexts had no token budget before model invocation
summary: The assistant API restarted under normal traffic
symptoms: Kubernetes pods were OOMKilled when concurrent prompts exceeded 30

description: Network alarms arrived more than twenty minutes late. Consumer lag exceeded 3.4 million events on nms.events.v2.
resolution: Quarantined the malformed event and resumed the partition from its committed offset
root_cause: A schema error sent one partition into a retry loop
summary: Network alarms arrived more than twenty minutes late
symptoms: Consumer lag exceeded 3.4 million events on nms.events.v2

description: Active assistant sessions lost recent context. Redis evicted session keys while memory was below the host limit.
resolution: Raised the reviewed container limit and separated session keys from cache keys
root_cause: The volatile-lru policy combined with a small container maxmemory caused eviction
summary: Active assistant sessions lost recent context
symptoms: Redis evicted session keys while memory was below the host limit

description: The assistant could not find recently ingested runbooks. The collection contained 7,412 of 9,806 expected chunks.
resolution: Moved acknowledgement after persistence and replayed the missing batch manifest
root_cause: The ingestion worker acknowledged batches before Chroma persisted them
summary: The assistant could not find recently ingested runbooks
symptoms: The collection contained 7,412 of 9,806 expected chunks

description: All new document embeddings failed validation. The vector store expected 1,536 dimensions but the endpoint returned 3,072.
resolution: Pinned the model deployment and rebuilt the affected collection from its manifest
root_cause: An embedding deployment changed without a versioned dataset configuration
summary: All new document embeddings failed validation
symptoms: The vector store expected 1,536 dimensions but the endpoint returned 3,072

description: A malicious ticket note attempted to override assistant instructions. The note contained ignore previous instructions and requested secret output.
resolution: Marked retrieved text as untrusted data and added injection-pattern rejection
root_cause: Ingested ticket text was treated as trusted prompt instructions
summary: A malicious ticket note attempted to override assistant instructions
symptoms: The note contained ignore previous instructions and requested secret output

description: Generated answers exposed subscriber identifiers from ticket notes. A response repeated an MSISDN and engineer email from retrieved evidence.
resolution: Moved PII filtering after generation and added a regression test for source excerpts
root_cause: Output filtering ran before rather than after response generation
summary: Generated answers exposed subscriber identifiers from ticket notes
symptoms: A response repeated an MSISDN and engineer email from retrieved evidence
